title: kate-ui: step one visual row on a wrapped line
summary: visual_step returns the display column one wrap row above or below a display column. A move past the first or last row returns None. A short last row lands on its last column. Command::MoveTo stays out of this packet. The test goes in the existing layout tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

definitions.definition: fn visual_step(line: &str, column: u32, columns: u32, tab_width: u8, delta: i32) -> Option<u32>

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: layout.rs has one test module named tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. The shim module stays after that brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Add visual_step. Keep it pub(crate). Add #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]. column is a display column. delta is -1 or 1. Use the same widths as visual_row_count. A tab advances to the next multiple of tab_width, and a tab_width of 0 counts as 1. A line break and U+200B add no width. Every other scalar adds 1. A columns value of 0 returns None. When the target row does not exist, return None. When the target row is shorter than the column inside the row, return the last display column of that row. Do not nest an if inside an if.  Do not write two if arms that return the same value. Combine them with ||. That is clippy::if_same_then_else. Do not change visual_row_count or is_line_break. Do not add a Command variant. The existing test a_zero_width_space_adds_no_row stays green. Do not rewrite its assertions. The test visual_step_moves_one_wrap_row checks these results. visual_step of abcdefghij, column 0, columns 4, tab width 4, delta 1 is Some(4). The same line at column 4 and delta 1 is Some(8). The same line at column 8 and delta 1 is None. The same line at column 5 and delta -1 is Some(1). The same line at column 0 and delta -1 is None. visual_step of abcdef, column 3, columns 4, tab width 4, delta 1 is Some(5). visual_step of a tab then b, column 0, columns 4, tab width 4, delta 1 is Some(4). That same text at column 4 and delta -1 is Some(0). visual_step of ab, column 0, columns 0, tab width 4, delta 1 is None. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines. Stay inside this one behavior. Run the full test module named in the commands, not only the new test.

regression_tests.name: layout::tests::visual_step_moves_one_wrap_row
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because visual_step does not exist. After the change column 0 on abcdefghij with width 4 steps down to column 4. Column 8 steps down to None. A tab of width 4 steps down from 0 to 4.
